content.short: PalmPay is a fast-growing African mobile wallet and payments app, most prominent in Nigeria, backed by Transsion.
content.description: PalmPay is a fast-growing African fintech and mobile wallet, most prominent in Nigeria, that gives millions of users a simple way to send money, pay bills, buy airtime and data, and earn rewards. Through its app and agent network, customers get a wallet and a bank account number recognized across Nigerian banks, plus transfers, savings, cashback and merchant payment tools, with debit cards and credit features rounding out the experience. Backed by the Transsion group, PalmPay has expanded across Africa and focuses on financial inclusion, reliability and low-cost transactions for consumers and small merchants. By combining wallets, accounts and rewards at scale, it competes to be a daily-use financial app.
